name: KeeperHub (LangChain SDK)
description: KeeperHub's full 24-tool LangChain SDK exposed as native OpenClaw tools. Includes DeFi protocols (Aave, Uniswap, Lido, Compound, Morpho), token transfers, workflow automation, ENS resolution, x402/MPP payments, ERC-8004 agent identity, Chainlink CCIP, and more.
author: KeeperHub Agent SDK

apiKey.description: KeeperHub API key (kh_ prefix). Get from app.keeperhub.com -> Settings -> API Keys.

testnetOnly.description: Block all mainnet write calls (transfer, contract write, check-and-execute). Recommended for development.

allowedChainIds.description: Allowlist of chain IDs (as strings). Only these chains can be used for writes.

tools.description: Which LangChain tools to expose. Defaults to all 24 tools.
